target: Current calendar month TSMC consolidated nominal revenue, TWD million
rule: Same target month a year earlier times the geometric mean of the latest three available year-over-year revenue ratios. Required last input is target minus two months. No imputation of the missing preceding month.
modelStatus: experimental_horizon_extension; the previous lag-one benchmark does not validate this horizon
recording: Actual system UTC capture time; target month must be ongoing; every input disclosure must precede capture. Exclusive file creation; no backdating, overwriting or replacement of a forecast for the same model and target.
evaluation: Score every captured record against matching original SEC outcome, retain pending cases; report absolute error, baseline error and interval coverage. Never label unobserved future outcomes as successful.
limitations: Local hashes detect later modifications but are not independent timestamp attestation.
Monthly revenue performance is not disruption-loss or chain-wide causal validation.
Prospective performance cannot be known before the outcomes occur.
